enemy.name: Sandfall Crystalhoof
enemy.flavour_text: An extremely rare and exquisite beast. It feeds on rhizomes, giving its coat a dense but fine light golden luster. When on the move, it's almost as if golden sand was falling from its body, so it is highly sought by collectors and artists. However, it is extremely nimble and difficult to capture, but is the secret ingredient spoken of in legends... do you really want to hunt it?

abilities.text: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time
